1: =======================================
2: dbus-python_: Python bindings for D-Bus
3: =======================================
4: 
5: .. _dbus-python: http://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/DBusBindings#python
6: 
7: dbus-python is the original Python binding for ``dbus``, the reference
8: implementation of the D-Bus protocol.
9: 
10: Online documentation can be found at
11: <http://dbus.freedesktop.org/doc/dbus-python/>.
12: 
13: Problems and alternatives
14: =========================
15: 
16: dbus-python might not be the best D-Bus binding for you to use. dbus-python
17: does not follow the principle of "In the face of ambiguity, refuse the
18: temptation to guess", and can't be changed to not do so without seriously
19: breaking compatibility.
20: 
21: In addition, it uses libdbus (which has known problems with multi-threaded
22: use) and attempts to be main-loop-agnostic (which means you have to select
23: a suitable main loop for your application).
24: 
25: Alternative ways to get your Python code onto D-Bus include, in no
26: particular order:
27: 
28: * GDBus, part of the GIO module of `GLib`_, via GObject-Introspection and
29:   `PyGI`_ (uses the GLib main loop and object model)
30: 
31: * `dasbus`_, a higher-level wrapper around GDBus
32: 
33: * QtDBus, part of `Qt`_, via `PyQt`_ (uses the Qt main loop and object model)
34: 
35: * `dbussy`_, a CTypes wrapper around libdbus using asyncio for event handling
36: 
37: * `dbus-next`_, a pure-Python implementation of the D-Bus protocol
38:   using asyncio for event handling
39: 
40: * `dbus-fast`_, a fork of dbus-next emphasizing performance
41: 
42: * `jeepney`_, a pure-Python implementation of the D-Bus protocol with
43:   support for several event loop models
44: 
45: Inclusion in this list is not intended to imply endorsement.
46: 
47: .. _GLib: http://developer.gnome.org/glib/
48: .. _PyGI: https://live.gnome.org/PyGObject
49: .. _Qt:   https://www.qt.io
50: .. _PyQT: http://www.riverbankcomputing.co.uk/software/pyqt/intro
51: .. _dasbus: https://github.com/rhinstaller/dasbus
52: .. _dbussy: https://github.com/ldo/dbussy
53: .. _dbus-fast: https://github.com/bluetooth-devices/dbus-fast
54: .. _dbus-next: https://github.com/altdesktop/python-dbus-next
55: .. _jeepney: https://gitlab.com/takluyver/jeepney

3:   "title": "PC third-party library analysis report",
4:   "description": "Final report produced by the pc-lib-analyzer agent. The languages/code_metrics/tests blocks come verbatim from the code-metrics script (deterministic); every other block is reasoned by the model via its skill.",
5:   "type": "object",
6:   "required": ["library", "function_summary", "languages", "code_metrics",
7:                "tests", "license", "dependencies", "native_api",
8:                "runtime_surface", "build_env", "harmony_adaptation", "meta"],
9:   "properties": {
10:     "library": {
11:       "type": "object",
12:       "required": ["name", "source_url"],
13:       "properties": {
14:         "name": {"type": "string"},
15:         "kind": {"type": "string",
16:           "description": "model: 被分析对象的性质。推荐取值（开放，可扩并记入 meta.observations）：library（被 API 调用的三方库）/ application（终端用户启动运行的应用，如桌面/CLI）/ framework / tool / cli / service / plugin / other。缺省/旧报告按 library 处理。决定 dim-9 鸿蒙口径：library→模型A/B（重编+链接/桥接），application→模型C（整包应用打包并启动）。"},
17:         "package_name": {"type": ["string", "null"],
18:           "description": "model: distribution/package name from the manifest (PyPI/npm/Maven artifact/crate name), may differ from the repo dir name. Used to link this library into other libraries' dependency trees. Null if none/uncertain."},
19:         "aliases": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
20:           "description": "model: 该库的其它已知名称（旧名/别名/常见拼写/CMake find_package 名/Maven groupId:artifactId 等），用于被别的库的依赖按名匹配上。无则省略或 []。"},
21:         "import_names": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
22:           "description": "model: 实际 import/引入时用的名字（如 PyPI Pillow → import PIL；包名≠导入名时尤其有用）。无则省略或 []。"},
23:         "source_url": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
24:         "analyzed_at": {"type": "string", "description": "ISO-8601 UTC"},
25:         "commit": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
26:         "one_liner": {"type": "string", "description": "model: <=120 char tagline"},
27:         "ecosystem": {
28:           "type": "string",
29:           "enum": ["python", "java", "nodejs", "cpp", "rust", "go", "dotnet", "other"],
30:           "description": "库的核心语言生态，由模型根据 manifest 与主语言判断。取值：python / java / nodejs / cpp / rust / go / dotnet / other"
31:         },
32:         "bindings": {
33:           "type": "array",
34:           "items": {"type": "string", "enum": ["python", "java", "nodejs", "cpp", "rust", "go", "dotnet", "other"]},
35:           "description": "model: 该库在核心生态之外对外提供绑定/包装的语言生态（如 C++ 核心 + Python/Java/C# 绑定 → [python, java, dotnet]）。无则 []。用于多语言库的生态展示。"
36:         }
37:       }
38:     },

40:     "function_summary": {
41:       "type": "object",
42:       "description": "Dimension 1 — MODEL (skill: function-summary). All prose fields here (summary, category name/description, domain, target_users) and library.one_liner are written in Simplified Chinese (简体中文).",
43:       "required": ["summary", "categories"],
44:       "properties": {
45:         "summary": {"type": "string", "description": "2-4 sentences: what it does, for whom."},
46:         "categories": {
47:           "type": "array",
48:           "description": "Capability groups the library provides.",
49:           "items": {
50:             "type": "object",
51:             "required": ["name", "description"],
52:             "properties": {
53:               "name": {"type": "string"},
54:               "description": {"type": "string"},
55:               "evidence": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
56:                 "description": "files/symbols/docs that support this category"}
57:             }
58:           }
59:         },
60:         "domain": {"type": "string", "description": "e.g. networking, graphics, ML, crypto"},
61:         "target_users": {"type": "string"}
62:       }
63:     },

65:     "languages": {
66:       "type": "object",
67:       "description": "Dimension 2 — SCRIPT (code-metrics).",
68:       "properties": {
69:         "primary": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
70:         "all": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
71:         "breakdown": {"type": "array", "items": {
72:           "type": "object",
73:           "description": "per-language totals; production/test/example split the same files by category",

75:             "language": {"type": "string"}, "files": {"type": "integer"},
76:             "code": {"type": "integer"}, "pct": {"type": "number"},
77:             "production": {"type": "object", "properties": {"files": {"type": "integer"}, "code": {"type": "integer"}}},
78:             "test": {"type": "object", "properties": {"files": {"type": "integer"}, "code": {"type": "integer"}}},
79:             "example": {"type": "object", "properties": {"files": {"type": "integer"}, "code": {"type": "integer"}}}}}}
80:       }

83:     "code_metrics": {
84:       "type": "object",
85:       "description": "Dimension 3 — SCRIPT (code-metrics). Splits prod/test/example.",
86:       "properties": {
87:         "tool": {"type": "string", "enum": ["cloc", "tokei", "builtin"]},
88:         "total": {"$ref": "#/definitions/lineAgg"},
89:         "production": {"$ref": "#/definitions/lineAgg"},
90:         "test": {"$ref": "#/definitions/lineAgg"},
91:         "example": {"$ref": "#/definitions/lineAgg"},
92:         "platform_adaptation": {
93:           "type": "object",
94:           "description": "各平台被编译宏(#ifdef _WIN32/__APPLE__/__linux__…)正向包裹的生产代码量（机械计数，C/C++/ObjC；#ifndef/!defined 不计）。作为鸿蒙适配复杂度信号之一供 dim-9 参考。",
95:           "properties": {
96:             "by_platform": {
97:               "type": "object",
98:               "description": "{windows|macos|linux|posix: {files, code, macros[]}}",
99:               "additionalProperties": {
100:                 "type": "object",
101:                 "properties": {
102:                   "files": {"type": "integer"},
103:                   "code": {"type": "integer", "description": "该平台守卫块内代码行"},
104:                   "macros": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}
105:                 }
106:               }
107:             },
108:             "total": {"type": "integer", "description": "各平台之和"},
109:             "notes": {"type": "string"}
110:           }
111:         },
112:         "platform_branches": {
113:           "type": "object",
114:           "description": "生产代码中运行时平台判断分支（sys.platform/process.platform/os.name/runtime.GOOS/cfg!(target_os)…）的机械计数（启发式）。补 platform_adaptation 漏掉的脚本/JVM/Go/Rust/C# 平台分支，作为 dim-9 第二个平台适配信号；C/C++ 编译宏由 platform_adaptation 覆盖，本项不计。",
115:           "properties": {
116:             "by_language": {
117:               "type": "object",
118:               "description": "{python|javascript|java|go|rust|csharp: {files, hits}}",
119:               "additionalProperties": {
120:                 "type": "object",
121:                 "properties": {
122:                   "files": {"type": "integer"},
123:                   "hits": {"type": "integer"}
124:                 }
125:               }
126:             },
127:             "by_platform": {
128:               "type": "object",
129:               "description": "启发式按命中行平台关键字归类 {windows|macos|linux|posix: hits}"
130:             },
131:             "samples": {
132:               "type": "array",
133:               "description": "样例命中位置（最多约 30 条，供核验与 codegraph 追踪种子）",
134:               "items": {
135:                 "type": "object",
136:                 "properties": {
137:                   "language": {"type": "string"},
138:                   "file": {"type": "string"},
139:                   "line": {"type": "integer"},
140:                   "text": {"type": "string"}
141:                 }
142:               }
143:             },
144:             "total": {"type": "integer", "description": "命中总数"},
145:             "notes": {"type": "string"}
146:           }
147:         }
148:       }

152:       "type": "object",
153:       "description": "Dimension 4 — SCRIPT counts; model may refine framework/notes.",
154:       "properties": {
155:         "test_files": {"type": "integer"},
156:         "test_cases": {"type": "integer"},
157:         "frameworks": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},

163:     "license": {
164:       "type": "object",
165:       "description": "Dimension 5 — MODEL (skill: license-detect).",
166:       "required": ["spdx", "confidence"],
167:       "properties": {
168:         "spdx": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "SPDX id, 'NOASSERTION', or null"},
169:         "name": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
170:         "confidence": {"type": "string", "enum": ["high", "medium", "low"]},
171:         "is_dual_licensed": {"type": "boolean"},
172:         "license_files": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
173:         "evidence": {"type": "string", "description": "what the call is based on"},

178:     "dependencies": {
179:       "type": "object",
180:       "description": "Dimension 6 — MODEL (skill: dependency-analysis).",
181:       "properties": {
182:         "count": {"type": "integer"},
183:         "manifests": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
184:         "by_ecosystem": {"type": "object"},
185:         "dependencies": {"type": "array", "items": {
186:           "type": "object",
187:           "required": ["name", "ecosystem"],
188:           "properties": {
189:             "name": {"type": "string"},
190:             "ecosystem": {"type": "string", "description": "LANGUAGE ecosystem only: cpp/c/python/java/nodejs/rust/go/dotnet/other. Use 'other' for non-language deps (data files, generic tools); do NOT put role values like 'tool'/'data' here — a dependency's build-tool nature belongs in scope:build."},
191:             "registry_name": {"type": ["string", "null"],
192:               "description": "model: 该依赖的规范/注册表包名（PyPI/npm/Maven artifact/crate；或 CMake find_package 的真实包名），当 `name` 是别名/接口名/缩写时填它，便于按名关联到已分析库。不确定则 null。"},
193:             "source_repo": {"type": ["string", "null"],
194:               "description": "model (best-effort): 该依赖的上游源码仓库 URL（github/gitlab/gitee/自托管均可）。是把依赖关联到已分析库的最强键——能从 manifest/lock/已知常识判断就填，含 `find_package(PNG)`→glennrp/libpng 这类名≠仓的情形。不确定则 null。"},
195:             "import_names": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
196:               "description": "model: 实际 import 名（如依赖 Pillow → 代码里 import PIL）。无则省略。"},
197:             "aliases": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
198:               "description": "model: 该依赖的其它已知名称/拼写。无则省略。"},
199:             "scope": {"type": "string", "description": "runtime/dev/test/optional/build"},
200:             "version": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
201:             "purpose": {"type": "string", "description": "model: why it's used"},
202:             "acquisition": {"type": "string",
203:               "description": "OPEN vocabulary — how the build OBTAINS this dependency. Recommended values: system (find_package/expected pre-installed), vendored (source copied into the tree), fetchcontent (CMake FetchContent), download_build (ExternalProject/custom download-source-and-build), submodule (git submodule), package_manager (vcpkg/conan/pip/npm/maven), prebuilt_binary (binary shipped in repo). If none fits, coin a concise lowercase token (e.g. conda, apt, cpm, git_subtree, runtime_download) AND record it in meta.observations. Also set the closed `locality` field accordingly."},
204:             "locality": {"type": "string",
205:               "enum": ["local", "remote", "system", "runtime", "unknown"],
206:               "description": "STABLE axis (model-set): local=already in repo (vendored/prebuilt); remote=pulled from outside (fetchcontent/download/submodule/registry); system=expected pre-installed via find_package; runtime=loaded at runtime; unknown"},
207:             "source": {"type": "string", "description": "model: WHERE it is obtained from — download URL / registry / 'system (find_package, must be pre-installed)' / in-tree path, 简体中文"},
208:             "declared_in": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
209:               "description": "model: repo file(s) that declare how this dependency is integrated, e.g. the CMakeLists.txt with find_package/FetchContent_Declare/ExternalProject_Add/target_link_libraries, a .gitmodules entry, or a requirements/manifest line"},
210:             "used_symbols": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
211:               "description": "model (best-effort, codegraph/grep): the dependency's public symbols / APIs THIS library actually calls (e.g. cairo_create, BIO_new, numpy.ndarray). Consumed by dim-9 bottom-up rollup: a child's un-adaptable API only blocks this (parent) library if it appears here. Omit/empty for system deps or when usage can't be pinned down (rollup then falls back to dependency scope)."},
212:             "harmony_adapted": {"type": "boolean", "description": "SCRIPT-stamped (scripts/harmony_adapted.js): true if this package already has an official HarmonyOS PC build in the OpenHarmony PC mirror (an *-ohos_*.whl etc.). Consumed by dim 9 (already-adapted dep ⇒ not a blocker). Do NOT set by hand."},
213:             "harmony_adapted_source": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "SCRIPT-stamped: which OpenHarmony PC mirror provides the adapted build."}}}},
214:         "notes": {"type": "string"}
215:       }

218:     "native_api": {
219:       "type": "object",
220:       "description": "Dimension 7 — MODEL (skill: native-api-analysis).",
221:       "properties": {
222:         "summary": {"type": "string"},
223:         "groups": {"type": "array", "items": {
224:           "type": "object",
225:           "required": ["type"],
226:           "properties": {
227:             "type": {"type": "string",
228:               "description": "API family, e.g. win32, posix, cpp_stl, python_stdlib, java_std, node_core, syscall, ctypes_ffi, jni, opengl, directx, arch_simd"},
229:             "category": {"type": "string",
230:               "enum": ["standard", "platform", "system", "ffi", "hardware"],
231:               "description": "按可移植性分类。standard=语言标准库/运行时,到处可用(C++ STL、Python stdlib、JDK标准包、Node内置); platform=某OS专有,换平台即没有(Win32 与 POSIX-only 如 mmap/fork/epoll/<unistd.h> 都属此,再用 platform 字段标 windows/posix/macos); system=内核/系统调用层(裸 syscall、ioctl、/proc、/sys、注册表、WMI、设备); ffi=互操作桥(ctypes/cffi/JNI/N-API); hardware=GPU/SIMD/加速器"},
232:             "platform": {"type": "string",
233:               "enum": ["windows", "posix", "linux", "macos", "portable", "unknown"],
234:               "description": "该组 API 所属平台；portable=跨平台(标准库)"},
235:             "apis": {"type": "array",
236:               "description": "逐个具体 API（代表性，非穷举）",
237:               "items": {
238:                 "type": "object",
239:                 "required": ["name"],
240:                 "properties": {
241:                   "name": {"type": "string", "description": "单个具体 API/符号名（如 mmap、CreateFileMapping、std::filesystem）。不要把多个调用并进一个 name（如 'mmap / munmap'），否则 count 失去意义"},
242:                   "purpose": {"type": "string", "description": "中文：该 API 的作用"},
243:                   "count": {"type": "integer", "description": "调用次数/出现次数（代表性近似，grep -c 或 codegraph callers）"},
244:                   "evidence": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
245:                     "description": "调用位置 file:line（代表性 1-3 处）"},
246:                   "conditional": {"type": "boolean", "description": "是否被 #ifdef / 平台条件守卫"}}}},
247:             "evidence": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
248:               "description": "group-level files / includes (optional; prefer per-api evidence)"}}}},
249:         "dynamic_libraries": {
250:           "type": "array",
251:           "description": "Libraries loaded at RUNTIME via dynamic loading (not declared in package manifests). Model resolves the loaded library name and infers its purpose.",
252:           "items": {
253:             "type": "object",
254:             "required": ["name"],
255:             "properties": {
256:               "name": {"type": "string", "description": "loaded library name, e.g. 'libssl.so', 'kernel32.dll', 'libcudart' (keep as written; '<dynamic>' if computed at runtime)"},
257:               "mechanism": {"type": "string",
258:                 "description": "how it is loaded: dlopen / LoadLibrary / ctypes.CDLL / ctypes.WinDLL / cffi.dlopen / JNI System.loadLibrary / node N-API addon"},
259:               "acquisition": {"type": "string",
260:                 "description": "OPEN vocab — HOW the loaded lib is obtained: self_build (built from THIS repo, e.g. a CFFI/JNI/SWIG wrapper), system (external/OS-provided), bundled (shipped in repo), third_party, unknown"},
261:               "source": {"type": "string", "description": "中文：是什么库 / 出处（身份与来源），如「本仓 MinimalLib 的 CFFI 构建产物」「外部专有 DLL，需 COMBICHEM_ROOT 提供」"},
262:               "description": {"type": "string", "description": "model-inferred purpose of the loaded library, 简体中文"},
263:               "optional": {"type": "boolean", "description": "true if load failure is handled gracefully (feature is optional)"},
264:               "evidence": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"},
265:                 "description": "file + call site"}}}},
266:         "platform_dependence": {"type": "string",
267:           "enum": ["cross-platform", "windows-only", "posix-only", "mixed", "unknown"]}
268:       }
